goals.title: no module is longer than 40 meaningful lines
goals.why: reporting.mjs parses, validates, aggregates, formats and exports. Five reasons to change one file, and no way to reuse any of them.

goals.title: no function is longer than 20 meaningful lines
goals.why: buildReport is a pipeline written as one body, so no stage can be tested, replaced or reasoned about on its own.

goals.title: no function has more than 5 branch points
goals.why: Every rejection rule is another branch in the same loop, and the loop also does the accepting.

goals.title: no logic is duplicated across modules
goals.why: Money formatting exists in reporting.mjs and receipts.mjs. Money that formats two ways is a bug waiting for a rounding change.
